next_iteration_focus.title: 创建Prettier配置（.prettierrc + .prettierignore）+ eslint-config-prettier

next_iteration_focus.title: 配置Husky v9 + lint-staged pre-commit钩子
next_iteration_focus.description: 安装husky v9 + lint-staged，npx husky init，配置.husky/pre-commit运行npx lint-staged。package.json添加prepare脚本和lint-staged配置（*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs}: eslint --fix + prettier --write；*.{json,md,yml,yaml,css}: prettier --write）。注意：AIToolCrux用GitHub API提交不用git push，本地hooks对其他贡献者有用。

next_iteration_focus.title: 配置commitlint + Conventional Commits规范
next_iteration_focus.description: 安装@commitlint/cli + @commitlint/config-conventional，创建commitlint.config.js。配置.husky/commit-msg运行npx --no -- commitlint --edit $1。当前commits已部分符合conventional commits（fix:/feat:），统一规范有助于自动化changelog生成。

next_iteration_focus.title: 在CI workflow中添加ESLint + Prettier检查步骤

next_iteration_focus.title: 审计所有动态路由的generateStaticParams覆盖情况
next_iteration_focus.description: 检查所有动态路由（blog/[slug]、tools/[slug]、blog/category/[slug]、subcategory/[slug]、authors/[slug]、og/[slug]、compare/[slug]）是否都有generateStaticParams。第96轮已修复category页no-store问题，需确认其他路由也正确预渲染。用next build输出检查○/λ/◐标记。

next_iteration_focus.title: 用unstable_cache包装JSON数据读取函数（getPost/getTool/getAllPosts）
next_iteration_focus.description: AIToolCrux从本地JSON文件读取数据不走fetch()，无法利用Data Cache。用unstable_cache包装getPost()、getTool()、getAllPosts()、getAllTools()等函数，设置revalidate: 3600（1小时）和tags: ['posts']/['tools']。减少每次请求的文件读取和JSON解析开销。注意unstable_cache在Next.js 14.2.5中的API签名。

next_iteration_focus.title: 用React cache()实现请求内数据获取去重
next_iteration_focus.description: 用import { cache } from 'react'包装数据获取函数，确保同一请求中多个组件调用getPost('same-slug')只执行一次。这是Request Memoization层，仅在单次请求内有效。与unstable_cache（跨请求持久化）配合使用形成双层缓存。

next_iteration_focus.title: 用force-static捕获意外动态依赖，优化渲染策略
next_iteration_focus.description: 在所有内容页临时设置export const dynamic = 'force-static'运行next build，捕获意外的动态依赖（如cookies()、headers()、searchParams、未缓存的fetch）。修复后移除force-static。目标：内容型页面全部静态渲染（○），只有需要实时数据的页面动态渲染（λ）。

next_iteration_focus.title: 用x-vercel-cache响应头审计线上缓存命中率
next_iteration_focus.description: 用Invoke-WebRequest或curl检查关键页面（首页、文章页、工具页、分类页、对比页）的x-vercel-cache响应头。目标：内容页应为HIT或PRERENDER，MISS/BYPASS说明未正确缓存。记录每个页面的缓存状态，定位需要修复的页面。可写一个Python脚本批量检查50个关键URL。

next_iteration_focus.title: 对blog/[slug]和tools/[slug]设置dynamicParams: false
next_iteration_focus.description: AIToolCrux有固定的106篇文章和533个工具，所有slug都在generateStaticParams中。设置dynamicParams: false确保未包含的参数返回404，避免恶意参数触发按需渲染（消耗函数调用额度）。注意：如果有通过CMS动态添加内容的需求则不适用，但AIToolCrux是静态内容站。

next_iteration_focus.title: 用Middleware集中处理旧URL重定向
next_iteration_focus.description: 从posts.json/tools.json读取旧slug映射，用Middleware动态处理重定向，避免在next.config中硬编码数百条重定向。使用NextResponse.redirect()，matcher限制范围。
next_iteration_focus.source: 学习主题：Next.js Middleware与Edge Runtime（知识点2+7）

next_iteration_focus.title: 基于地理位置的区域化内容

next_iteration_focus.source: 学习主题：Next.js Middleware与Edge Runtime（知识点8）

next_iteration_focus.title: CTA按钮A/B测试（Middleware实现）
next_iteration_focus.description: 用Middleware实现无闪烁A/B测试：检查cookie中的实验组，随机分配并设置cookie，NextResponse.rewrite()到对应变体页面。适合CTA文案、定价页布局实验。
next_iteration_focus.source: 学习主题：Next.js Middleware与Edge Runtime（知识点9）

next_iteration_focus.title: 管理员后台认证守卫（Middleware）

next_iteration_focus.source: 学习主题：Next.js Middleware与Edge Runtime（知识点10）

next_iteration_focus.title: Middleware性能审计与最佳实践
next_iteration_focus.description: 添加任何Middleware时必须遵循性能最佳实践：使用matcher排除静态资源（_next/static、_next/image、favicon.ico），保持轻量避免复杂计算，不导入大型库（Edge Function体积限制1-4MB压缩后），优先用next.config做静态重定向。
next_iteration_focus.source: 学习主题：Next.js Middleware与Edge Runtime（知识点14）

next_iteration_focus.title: Next.js 15升级前审计：fetch缓存与异步API变更点排查
next_iteration_focus.description: 升级前审计所有fetch调用（标记需要cache:force-cache的）和cookies()/headers()/params使用（标记需要加await的）。Next.js 15两大破坏性变更：fetch默认不再缓存、cookies/headers/params变为异步。输出需修改的文件清单。

next_iteration_focus.title: 搜索框与筛选表单改用React 19 Actions+useActionState
next_iteration_focus.description: 搜索框和工具筛选表单改用Actions模式：form action属性+useActionState管理pending状态，useOptimistic实现乐观更新。替代当前的手动onSubmit+useState模式，提升交互体验和渐进增强支持。

next_iteration_focus.title: Partial Prerendering试点：工具列表页与首页PPR增量采用
next_iteration_focus.description: 在next.config中启用experimental.ppr: 'incremental'，在工具列表页和首页导出experimental_ppr=true，验证静态shell+动态内容（Suspense流式）的性能提升。对比PPR前后的TTFB和FCP数据。子段可设experimental_ppr=false禁用。

next_iteration_focus.title: GA4事件追踪改用after API异步执行
next_iteration_focus.description: GA4EventTracker中的事件上报改用Next.js 15 after API，在响应流式传输完成后异步执行，不阻塞页面渲染。替代当前的直接调用模式，减少对关键渲染路径的影响。需升级到Next.js 15.1+（after API稳定）。

next_iteration_focus.title: Next.js 14→15升级计划制定与开发分支测试

next_iteration_focus.title: Vitest测试框架初始化与Next.js集成配置

archived_todos.title: 窗口5：评估Perplexity Comet Plus发布商分成

archived_todos.title: 窗口1：工具详情页实体属性标注优化
archived_todos.description: 命名实体比模糊引用更易被AI提取引用。检查533个工具详情页是否清晰标注：名称、分类、价格、免费额度、竞品、上线时间、开发者。确保schema.org Product/SoftwareApplication标记准确反映页面真实内容。

archived_todos.title: 窗口3：强化直接答案结构——每篇文章前100字给结论
archived_todos.description: 跨平台GEO核心：AI系统提取直接回答问题的段落，前100字必须给答案不铺垫。检查现有文章开头是否直接给结论，对铺垫过长的文章重写开头。每个H2下段落应自成完整答案不依赖上下文(不要"如上所述/如下")。

archived_todos.title: 窗口1：评估Firecrawl/Crawl4AI用于竞品内容分析和截图验证
archived_todos.description: Firecrawl(149K星)和Crawl4AI(67K星)是AI原生爬虫，可把任意网站转成干净markdown/AI可用数据。可用于：批量抓取竞品文章结构做内容分析、验证我们引用的工具页面是否还在线、批量检查外链目标页是否404。评估哪个更适合本地部署。

archived_todos.title: 窗口1/4：借鉴Claude SEO的9并行agent审计方法论优化现有审计流程
archived_todos.description: Claude SEO(16.7K星)用9个AI agent并行审计网站，12分钟出0-100健康分+证据+优先级行动清单。我们不能直接用(需Claude Code)，但可借鉴其方法论：把现有审计拆成技术SEO/内容/schema/性能/链接/GEO 6个并行检查维度，每个维度独立出问题清单，最后汇总优先级。当前窗口1/4的审计是串行的，可优化为并行。

archived_todos.title: 窗口4：评估zens.ink SEO包做零成本关键词研究
archived_todos.description: zens.ink是2026年9月新出的20个CLI SEO工具，零Python依赖，用免费公开数据源(Google Autocomplete/Bing Webmaster/GSC/Brave Search/Ahrefs DR)做关键词研究和竞品分析。不需要DataForSEO付费。评估是否能替代或补充OpenSEO的关键词研究功能。

archived_todos.title: 窗口2：Build in Public——在X/Twitter和Indie Hackers分享多Agent运营网站的过程
archived_todos.description: 不晒收入截图，写技术决策日志/失败实验/成本透明/用户对话。我们的"6个AI窗口24小时自动运营一个网站"本身就是极具传播性的故事。HN一篇好帖能带5000+UV/天。每周发2条build in public内容。

archived_todos.title: 窗口2：建立社区参与SOP（Reddit/Indie Hackers/Discord）
archived_todos.description: 社区参与框架：第1-4周只听和贡献(不提产品)，第5-8周分享相关经验，第9周+才有资格推广。目标社区：r/artificial、r/SaaS、r/ChatGPT、Indie Hackers、3-5个AI工具Discord。每天30分钟真回答问题。

archived_todos.title: Wrap non-urgent CTA click tracking in requestIdleCallback
archived_todos.how_to: In components/monetization/AffiliateCTA.tsx trackCtaClick(), defer window.va.track and CustomEvent dispatch via requestIdleCallback (fallback setTimeout 0), so click→new window opens immediately.

archived_todos.how_to: Check Next.js 14.2.5 -> 16 Breaking Changes, dependency compatibility (Tailwind, next-seo, all custom components), produce a migration checklist. Don't upgrade until checklist is green.

archived_todos.title: Wrap non-critical blog/tool page data in Suspense so static HTML shell ships instantly

archived_todos.title: Wrap tools.json lookups in React.cache to dedupe renders
archived_todos.how_to: In Next.js 14, use React.cache() around getToolBySlug()/getCategoryTools() so multiple components in the same request don't re-read and re-process tools.json.

archived_todos.title: Verify Review schema via Google Rich Results Test on 5 tool pages
archived_todos.how_to: Run Rich Results Test on /tools/chatgpt, /tools/midjourney, /tools/cursor, /tools/perplexity, /tools/elevenlabs. Confirm no aggregateRating errors.

archived_todos.title: Blog post pages: check if Review schema is correctly applied
archived_todos.how_to: Audit /blog/* pages for Review JSON-LD. Blog reviews should also use reviewRating only (single editorial review), not aggregateRating.

archived_todos.title: 错开GitHub Actions cron整点时间
archived_todos.how_to: 把gsc-fetch、context-update、uptime-monitor三个workflow的cron从整点改成错开5-10分钟（如01,31分），避免GitHub高峰丢弃任务

archived_todos.how_to: 确认GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON等每个敏感值单独建Secret，不要拼JSON blob；确认Secret Scanning和Push Protection已开启

archived_todos.title: 给所有workflow加workflow_dispatch手动触发
archived_todos.how_to: 每个workflow文件on字段加workflow_dispatch，修复后可在Actions页面手动触发不用等cron

archived_todos.title: Use setup-node cache:'npm' instead of manual actions/cache for deps
archived_todos.how_to: In new workflows, prefer actions/setup-node with cache:'npm' (auto-handles ~/.npm). Only use manual actions/cache for .next/cache build output. restore-keys with prefix for partial fallback.

archived_todos.title: Verify layout.tsx uses next/font self-hosted, not external Google Fonts link
archived_todos.how_to: Check app/layout.tsx. If it uses <link> to fonts.googleapis.com, replace with next/font/google (e.g. Inter/Geist). Specify subsets:['latin'], display:'swap'. Eliminates external DNS lookup and FOUT.

archived_todos.title: Audit Article schema on 105 blog posts: add dateModified, author Organization, 1920x1080 image
archived_todos.description: Google Article schema recommended fields: headline, image (ImageObject min 1920x1080), datePublished, dateModified, author (Person/Organization), publisher. Batch check data/posts.json: ensure every post has updatedAt -> dateModified, author = AIToolCrux Research Team Organization, coverImage dimensions >= 1920x1080.

archived_todos.title: FAQPage schema: keep for AI/GEO, do not optimize for Google rich stars
archived_todos.description: Google FAQ rich results deprecated 2026-05-07, Rich Results Test FAQ support removed 2026-06, Search Console API FAQ support removed 2026-08. Keep FAQPage JSON-LD (helps Perplexity/ChatGPT answer extraction) but stop treating FAQ as a Google rich snippet lever. Ignore GSC FAQ warnings.

archived_todos.title: Audit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD structure: position starts at 1, name, item URL
archived_todos.description: Spot-check 10 tool pages: BreadcrumbList should be ItemList of ListElement items with position (1,2,3...), name, item (absolute URL). Fix any flat ItemList or missing position fields.

archived_todos.title: Preload LCP element with fetchpriority=high
archived_todos.description: Use Chrome DevTools Performance panel to identify LCP element on homepage and top blog posts. If it's a hero image, add <link rel=preload as=image fetchpriority=high> in head. Target TTFB < 400ms, LCP < 2.5s.

archived_todos.title: Audit raw tags for missing width/height
archived_todos.description: next/image auto-reserves aspect-ratio. But any raw in custom components must have width/height attributes or CSS aspect-ratio. Also check cookie banners / ad slots above fold have reserved min-height. Target CLS < 0.1.

archived_todos.title: Debounce high-frequency event handlers; yield in long loops
archived_todos.description: Audit scroll/resize/input/keydown handlers in tool list, search, pagination. Add debounce/throttle. In heavy map/filter loops, insert await scheduler.yield() (or yieldToMain polyfill) to let browser paint. Target INP < 200ms.

archived_todos.title: Measure TTFB on key pages via PageSpeed Insights
archived_todos.description: SSG on Vercel should have TTFB < 200ms. Run PSI on /, /ranking, /compare, /tools/chatgpt. If TTFB > 400ms, check Vercel edge cache and Cache-Control headers. TTFB slow = all LCP optimizations capped.

archived_todos.title: Audit all .github/workflows/*.yml: declare explicit permissions per job
archived_todos.description: Every workflow should set `permissions: contents: read` at top, then elevate per-job (e.g. issues: write, pull-requests: write). Repo-level default should be read-only. Source: GitHub secure-use docs.

archived_todos.title: Pin all third-party actions to full commit SHA; add Dependabot
archived_todos.description: Replace `uses: owner/action@v5` with full 40-char commit SHA. Add .github/dependabot.yml with package-ecosystem: github-actions to auto-PR upgrades. Trivy supply-chain event proved tags are mutable.

archived_todos.title: Audit workflows for shell injection via github.event context
archived_todos.description: Find any `run: echo ${{ github.event.* }}` patterns. Move to env: block and reference $ENV_VAR in shell. Especially check issue-comment / PR-triggered workflows.

archived_todos.title: Add concurrency block to scheduled workflows
archived_todos.description: Add `concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: false }` to gsc-fetch, context-update, uptime-monitor to prevent overlapping runs wasting minutes.

archived_todos.title: Verify scheduled cron times use Asia/Shanghai timezone
archived_todos.description: GitHub Actions now supports top-level `timezone: Asia/Shanghai`. Audit cron expressions: if they were written assuming UTC, add timezone field or recalculate. Also verify workflows exist on default branch (main) or they won't run.

archived_todos.title: Audit public/llms.txt: H1 + blockquote + H2 sections + markdown links
archived_todos.description: Per llms.txt spec: first line `# Site Name`, then `> one-line description`, then `## Category` sections each with `- [text](url)` links. List top reviews, compare pages, blog posts, category pages. Source: llmstxt.studio.

archived_todos.title: Explicitly allow AI search crawlers in robots.txt
archived_todos.description: Add User-agent blocks for OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-User with Allow: /. Keep training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) allowed too — being in training data helps. Source: capston.ai + landkit.pro.

archived_todos.title: Add ## FAQ section (3-5 Q&A pairs) to every blog post
archived_todos.description: Perplexity and Claude directly extract explicit Q&A pairs. Use `## FAQ` then `### Q: ...` followed by direct answer sentence. Improves AI citation rate. Source: crawlraven + linksurge.jp.

archived_todos.title: Inject concrete numbers and inline source citations in blog posts
archived_todos.description: GEO research: adding specific numbers/percentages/dates boosts visibility +40%; adding inline source citations boosts +115% for mid-ranked pages. Add pricing, monthly visit estimates, accuracy percentages, and link to original sources. Source: aithinkerlab GEO 2026.

archived_todos.title: Consider adding public/llms-full.txt for full content index
archived_todos.description: llms.txt is curated summary; llms-full.txt is full content for AI crawlers. For a 533-tool directory, generate a full index listing all tool pages + blog posts with one-line descriptions. Source: llms-txt-generator.de 2026.

archived_todos.title: Audit tsconfig.json strict mode and enable noImplicitAny + strictNullChecks

archived_todos.title: Run @next/bundle-analyzer to identify largest client chunks and replace heavy libraries

Check for heavy libraries that can be replaced: moment.js->dayjs, lodash->lodash-es/es-toolkit, axios->native fetch. Record findings in iteration_center/. This is a read-only analysis task (no code changes needed unless replacements are obvious).

archived_todos.title: Audit heavy Client Components for next/dynamic lazy loading or Server Component conversion

archived_todos.title: 接入 Sentry Next.js SDK 做前端错误追踪+Session Replay
archived_todos.why: 当前网站无任何 JS 错误监控，用户遇到白屏/报错无法感知。Sentry 提供错误聚合+堆栈追踪+分布式tracing+Session Replay，Next.js 专用 SDK 支持 App Router
archived_todos.how_to: 1. npm install @sentry/nextjs 2. npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i nextjs（自动配置）3. 配置 tracesSampleRate: 生产0.1/开发1.0 4. 启用 Session Replay: replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0 5. DSN 存入 Vercel Environment Variable（SENTRY_DSN），不硬编码 6. 部署后触发测试错误验证上报

archived_todos.title: 评估用 Uptime Kuma 替代 GitHub Actions uptime-monitor
archived_todos.why: 当前 GitHub Actions uptime-monitor 10分钟间隔，Uptime Kuma 可 20秒间隔+90+通知渠道+SSL证书到期监控+内置状态页，84k+ stars MIT协议
archived_todos.how_to: 1. Docker 部署 Uptime Kuma 到自有 VPS（docker run -d --restart=always -p 3001:3001 -v uptime-kuma:/app/data louislam/uptime-kuma:1）2. 配置 aitoolcrux.com HTTP 监控（20s间隔，非200/308告警）3. 配置 Telegram+Email 告警 4. 配置 SSL 证书到期前30天提醒 5. 评估稳定后可停用 GitHub Actions uptime-monitor

archived_todos.title: 引入 Turborepo 加速 GitHub Actions CI 构建缓存
archived_todos.why: 当前 lighthouse-ci.yml 和其他 workflow 每次全量 npm install + build，无构建缓存。Turborepo Remote Cache 可跨 CI run 共享产物

archived_todos.title: 添加Playwright E2E测试关键用户流程（首页/工具详情CTA/文章FAQ schema）
